program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    if len(counts) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    rare = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    return [[0 if value == rare else rare for value in row] for row in grid]
'''

p.write_text(program)
print(p.read_text())
